desc: Implement full solution: adjacency list + iterative BFS for potentials/consistency (handles self-loops, multi-edges, isolated vertices, M=0), per-component bit counting (30 bits), optimal flip t (bit b set iff 2*cnt1[b] > size), reconstruct A[v] = p[v] ^ t, output.

Verify correctness mentally on samples 1-3 and edge cases (M=0, self-loop with z=0 vs z≠0, parallel edges, isolated vertices); confirm complexity O((N+M)·30) and that 30 bits suffice (Z ≤ 1e9 < 2^30; higher bits in t only increase sum).
